public_api.name: Store
public_api.purpose: Open isolated cron SQLite state; injected aware datetime clock

public_api.name: Store.create
public_api.signature: create(*, name, prompt, project, scope, at, timezone="Asia/Dhaka", every=None, retries=0, retry_delay=60, delivery_target=None)
public_api.purpose: Persist one-shot or elapsed-interval schedule and JSON destination

public_api.name: Store.claim
public_api.purpose: Atomic run claim with schedule advance; returns JSON snapshot

public_api.name: Store.finish
public_api.purpose: Persist terminal result and optional delivery atomically

public_api.name: Store management
public_api.signature: list(); runs(); pause(ident); resume(ident); delete(ident); interrupt(ident)
public_api.purpose: Inspect/manage schedules and manually interrupt stopped executions

public_api.name: Store delivery
public_api.signature: deliveries(); claim_delivery(); finish_delivery(ident, token, *, status, error=None, retry_delay=60); abandon_delivery(ident)
public_api.purpose: Inspect, claim, settle and manually fence abandoned sends

public_api.name: Worker
public_api.signature: Worker(store, executor, deliver=None); tick() -> dict | None
public_api.purpose: Execute one due run; legacy delivery callback receives completed run

public_api.name: DeliveryWorker
public_api.signature: DeliveryWorker(store, send, *, max_attempts=3, retry_delay=60); tick() -> dict | None
public_api.purpose: Drain one pending delivery independently from execution

public_api.name: RetryDelivery
public_api.purpose: Only raise when transport certifies no acceptance; allows safe retry

executor_contract.interface: executor(run: dict) -> str; send(item: dict) -> None
inputs: run: id, schedule_id, scheduled_at, attempt, JSON snapshot with prompt/project/scope/timezone/delivery_target
send item: stable id, decoded target, completed run, attempt and token; adapter authorizes target at send time
outputs: executor string saved durably, exception triggers opt-in bounded execution retry
send returns after confirmed acceptance; RetryDelivery means definitely not accepted; other exceptions mean unknown

storage.migration_notes: Add deliveries table and nullable schedules.delivery_target; existing tasks/runs preserved and no historical sends backfilled. Initialize upgrade before workers start. No Telegram migration.

shared_file_changes: Coordinator only: route main CLI to cron.__main__.main; inject authorized execution/session and delivery adapters

limitations: Elapsed interval only; calendar cron and configurable catch-up/grace pending
Consumed one-shots remain due indefinitely until claimed; no expiration policy yet
Unknown execution/send outcomes require operator review, never automatic reclaim
Destination JSON is routing metadata, not authorization; adapters must enforce current access
Delivery retries require consistent configured policy across worker restarts
No live channel/model/daemon checks; no exactly-once external effects
Chat management and combined pipeline remain coordinator integration work
